name: runivo

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/mobile && tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: eslint apps/web/app apps/web/components apps/web/lib apps/mobile/src packages/shared/src
scripts.clean: npm run clean:mobile && npm run clean:web
scripts.functions:serve: npm run engine:sync && supabase functions serve
scripts.functions:deploy: npm run engine:sync && supabase functions deploy

comment:overrides: H-10 (security audit). postcss: @expo/metro-config pins postcss 8.4.x, so without this
override npm nests a second, older copy (8.4.49) next to the hoisted 8.5.x. With it the
tree has one postcss. package-lock.json already reflects it (npm records no 'overrides'
key in the lockfile; checked 2026-11-24: regenerating the lock with and without this
override differs only by that nested copy).
sharp: override removed on the same date. apps/web depends on ^0.35.3 directly and
next@15.5.x accepts ^0.35.5, so it changed nothing. Re-check postcss on the next
Expo SDK upgrade and drop the override if @expo/metro-config moves to 8.5.
